component.name: Glypdl
component.summary: A lightweight native Linux graphical frontend for yt-dlp

description.p: Glypdl is a fast, native GTK4/libadwaita download manager that interfaces seamlessly with the system-installed yt-dlp tool. Designed for modern GNOME desktop environments, it offers rich download controls, format selection, network throughput metrics, download queuing, and complete download history tracking.

ul.li: Native GNOME/libadwaita look and feel with dark/light mode support
Audio-only, Video-only, and Video+Audio download modes
Smooth real-time network throughput and ETA calculations
History tracking powered by a local SQLite database
Zero web wrappers or heavy runtimes

description.p: Initial release of Glypdl native download manager.
